app.title: Vancouver Seat Viewer
app.tagline: See the view before you book.
app.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project — not affiliated with Cineplex Entertainment.
app.dataNote: Seat maps are typed in by hand from booking-page screenshots.
home.heading: Pick a theatre
home.intro: Choose a theatre, an auditorium and a seat. Then sit down and see the screen from there.
home.empty: No theatres are set up yet. Add one to data/theatres.json.
theatre.heading: Pick an auditorium
theatre.hint: Match the seat map with the one on your Cineplex booking page.
theatre.empty: This theatre has no auditoriums yet. See docs/add-auditorium.md to add one.
badge.estimatedHint: Room sizes are defaults, not measured here, so distances and angles are approximate.
badge.sampleHint: Not a real seat map. Replace it with the real auditorium.
trailer.heading: Pick a trailer
trailer.intro: It plays on the screen once you sit down.
trailer.listHeading: In theatres now or coming soon
trailer.noList: No trailers are loaded yet. Paste any YouTube link instead.
trailer.pasteHelp: Watch, youtu.be, Shorts and embed links all work.
trailer.errorInvalid: That isn't a YouTube video link. Try one like youtube.com/watch?v=… or youtu.be/…
seat.name: Row {row}, Seat {seat}
seatmap.heading: Pick a seat and sit down
seatmap.gridLabel: Seat map. The screen is at the top. Use the arrow keys to move between seats.
seatmap.preselected: You start on the best-rated seat. Tap any seat to compare.
verdict.ok: Easy to take in, a little distant
verdict.avoidTooClose: Turn your head to see it all
verdict.avoidNeck: You look up the whole time
verdict.offAxis: Good distance, but off to the side
verdict.mehOffAxis: Far away and off to the side
view.canvasLabel: View from {seat}. Drag or use the arrow keys to look around.
view.miniMapLabel: Your seat on the seat map
view.fallbackNote: The video can't play on the screen on this device. Open it on YouTube instead.
view.videoBlocked: YouTube doesn't allow this video to play on other sites. Open it on YouTube instead.
view.webglError: This device can't show the 3D view. Seat ratings still work on the seat map.
view.seatNotFound: That seat isn't in this auditorium. Pick one on the seat map.
error.theatreNotFound: That theatre isn't in the list.
error.auditoriumNotFound: That auditorium isn't in this theatre.
error.auditoriumInvalid: This auditorium's file has a problem, so it can't be shown.
editor.heading: Auditorium editor
editor.intro: Paste a compact seat map, tune the dimensions, check both previews, then download the JSON.
editor.textHelp: One row per line, front row first. Example: A: 1-4 | 5-10 | 11-14. Use | for an aisle and _ for a missing seat.
editor.idHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, for example riverport-07.
editor.name: Name
editor.dimensionsHelp: Leave a value on its default unless you measured it. Only changed values are saved.
editor.verified: I measured these dimensions in the room
editor.previewSeat: Previewing {seat}. Tap a seat on the map to move.
editor.empty: Paste a seat map to see the previews.
editor.idInvalid: Give the auditorium an id before downloading.
compact.missingColon: Put a colon after the row label, like A: 1-10
compact.badLabel: The row label must be 1 to 4 characters
compact.badToken: Can't read “{token}”. Use numbers, ranges like 1-10, | or _
compact.duplicateSeat: Seat {seat} appears twice in this row
compact.tooManySeats: A row can have at most {max} seats
compact.tooManyRows: An auditorium can have at most {max} rows
